title: Nef but Non-Semi-positive Line Bundles on Hopf Manifolds
summary: We give a complete characterization of the nef, effective, pseudo-effective, and semi-positive cones on Hopf manifolds. In particular, by computing the Ueda classes on non-diagonal Hopf surfaces, we show that the invariant elliptic curve is nef but not semi-positive. Via Bott--Chern cohomology calculations, we construct new examples of nef but non-semi-positive line bundles on Hopf manifolds of arbitrary dimension.
